PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-works-how|How Payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

The infrastructure problem of selling digital products without access to conventional payment processors is not a trivial matter. It requires a fundamental shift in how creators approach commerce, from relying on third-party platforms to owning and operating their own sovereign digital commerce stacks. This means designing, documenting, and deploying custom infrastructure that gives creators full control over their online stores, automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built around a set of free and open-source tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These tools are combined to create a custom digital commerce stack that is both scalable and secure. NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, is then integrated to enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC or buyer account requirements.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign commerce solution is specifically designed for digital creators operating in countries or regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. It offers a permanent structural alternative to the base layer, enabling creators to collect payments, deliver products, and manage orders without relying on third-party platforms. The solution is not a workaround, but a fundamental shift in the architecture of digital commerce, empowering creators to take control of their online stores and commerce operations.
Building a sovereign digital commerce stack is not just about avoiding payment processor restrictions, but about empowering creators to take control of their online stores and commerce operations.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack, for instance, is a custom digital commerce stack that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours and configured for 5 products, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC set up for email deliverability and end-to-end testing. This stack provides a robust and scalable foundation for digital creators to build and manage their online stores, with full control over payment processing, product delivery, and data ownership.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs, from the Edge Commerce Stack to the Sovereign Starter Stack. They can then follow a series of concrete steps, including setting up hosting, configuring backend logic, integrating payment gateways, and deploying files. By following these steps, creators can build and manage their own custom digital commerce stacks, empowering them to take control of their online stores and commerce operations.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The most important question to answer is: how do I sell digital products online without relying on conventional payment processors? The answer is to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, using free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments, and integrating them to create a custom digital commerce stack that gives you full control over payment processing, product delivery, and data ownership.
Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is built around free and open-source tools, making it a cost-effective and scalable solution for digital creators.

For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other countries where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a custom digital commerce solution that can be deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. To learn more, visit the Core Merch shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and explore the Edge Commerce Stack and other sovereign commerce solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
